title: Polynomial-time computability of the length encoding
statement: The function sending a Boolean word $z$ to the binary expansion of the length of the second component extracted by the total second projection of the encoded second and third components of $z$, followed by a string of zeros whose length is the length of the total fourth projection of $z$, is polynomial-time computable.
